history_compression.kind: Lossless gzip only; exact original UTF-8 JSON bytes round-trip. Scientific envelope and publication attachment paths/hashes/lengths updated; below-threshold legacy exception removed.

limitations: Four same-allocation AB/BA process pairs per size. Large pairs use two PRO6000 GPUs with pairs0/1 and2/3 respectively; bootstrap resamples whole pairs and is descriptive for this campaign, not a hardware-population guarantee.

No new GPU kernels or generated scientific equations; the parent full56 unfiltered memcheck is retained in #1751. This change qualifies new CPU storage with real allocation interception and independent spectra.

One exploratory binary cast curvature into an integer diagnostic. That discarded measurement and two interrupted comparison allocations are excluded; all retained calls use the corrected full-precision label.
The frozen production delta predates a Windows skip and additional high-dynamic-range spectral tests, plus documentation/evidence edits. Compiled production sources match exactly.
Numeric capacity excludes allocator metadata, CUDA context and stacks; no total-device-memory measurement claimed.
